id.description: Material id (1-64 characters), unique across all entities. Reference it from finishes and defaults.

kind.description: "paint" is a flat colour; "texture" adds a PBR texture set (needs textureUrl). Cannot change once defined.

color.description: Base colour as #rrggbb. For textures it is the fallback and tint colour.

roughness.description: Surface roughness from 0 (mirror) to 1 (matte). Defaults to 0.9.

textureUrl.description: Texture set as "lib:<slug>"; read materials://list for the available slugs. Required when kind is "texture".

textureScale.description: Size in metres of one texture tile. Optional.

material.description: The complete material. An existing id is fully replaced (omitted optional fields are cleared); kind cannot change.

index.description: Internal (used by undo): insert position. Do not send.

id.description: Id of the material to delete (sceneMaterials[].id from list_materials). Fails with precondition_failed while any wall, room or default uses it.

wallId.description: Id of the wall (walls[].wallId from describe_room).

side.description: Which face of the wall. "left" is the left of someone walking from the wall start to its end on the plan (plan y grows down; describe_room gives the side that faces each room), "right" the other face, "both" both faces. With roomId, "both" means every face of this wall that the room adjoins.

materialId.description: Id of a defined material (sceneMaterials[].id from list_materials, or materials[].id from get_scene_summary with detail "full"), or null to clear back to the default. To use a library texture first call material_define with textureUrl "lib:<slug>" (library[].slug from list_materials).

roomId.description: The room whose stretch of this wall side to paint (rooms[].id from list_rooms). Strongly recommended: a wall side can be shared by several rooms (e.g. the alcove and the sejour) and without roomId the whole side is painted for all of them. Fails with precondition_failed if the room does not border that side. A room-scoped finish beats the whole-side finish and room_set_wall_finish.

wallId.description: Id of the wall (walls[].wallId from describe_room).

structural.description: true marks the wall structural (cannot be removed); false marks it removable; null clears the explicit mark so it is derived (exterior or at least 15 cm thick means structural). Only a user may set false on a wall that is structural by default.

roomId.description: Id of the room (rooms[].id from list_rooms).

rotation.description: Absolute rotation in degrees, counter-clockwise seen from above (the front faces plan +y at 0).

id.description: Id of the item (items[].id from describe_room or get_scene_summary).

variant.description: Variant SKU of the product (variants[].sku); null clears it.

name.description: Product name as listed by the provider.

price.description: Shelf price including VAT (TTC) in `currency`, as returned by the server.

d.description: Depth in metres (item-local z; the front is at +d/2).

h.description: Height in metres (item-local y, measured up from the item bottom).

dims.description: Assembled outer dimensions in metres, as returned by the server.

snapshotAt.description: When the facts were read from the provider (ISO 8601 date-time).

colour.description: Chosen colour when the product has several. Optional.

product.description: Snapshot of the chosen variant (resolved by the server from its record; never invented). Optional.

d.description: Depth in metres (item-local z; the front is at +d/2).

h.description: Height in metres (item-local y, measured up from the item bottom).

dims.description: Dimensions of the chosen variant when they differ; null clears them back to the product dimensions. Optional.

kind.description: Mesh source discriminator, always "provider": the provider's real model of productRef, streamed by the local server.
Mesh source discriminator, always "lookalike": a library model scaled to the exact dims.
Mesh source discriminator, always "parametric": a generator at the exact dims.

params.description: Scalar generator parameters; omitted keys use the generator defaults.

mesh.description: Shape source to store with the variant; null clears it. Omitted: a parametric shape follows the new dimensions. Optional.

id.description: Id of the item (items[].id from describe_room or get_scene_summary).

commands.description: Commands applied in order and atomically: all succeed or none apply. Batches cannot nest.
